title: On the Fairness of Privacy Protection: Measuring and Mitigating the Disparity of Group Privacy Risks for Differentially Private Machine Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and group privacy risks within differentially private machine learning. While it addresses 'fairness' which is an ethical principle, it does so through technical metrics and mitigation strategies for standard ML models (CNNs, MLPs) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, spiritual traditions, or general moral frameworks.
